metadata.title: The 1st Graph-Based Tajweed App
metadata.description: Learn Makharijul Huruf & Sifatul Huruf through interactive knowledge graphs. The first app that visualizes tajweed rules as interconnected nodes.

articulation_point.jauf: The empty space within the mouth and throat cavity.
articulation_point.aqsha_halq: The deepest part of the throat (furthest from the mouth cavity), specifically at the vocal cords (larynx).
articulation_point.wasath_halq: The middle part of the throat, specifically at the epiglottis (lisaanul mizmar).
articulation_point.adna_halq: The upper part of the throat (nearest to the mouth cavity), where the root of the tongue meets the uvula.
articulation_point.aqsha_lisan: The back of the tongue touching the soft palate (the fleshy part of the roof of the mouth).
articulation_point.aqsha_lisan_asfal: The back of the tongue (slightly below the Qaf makhraj) touching the junction of the soft and hard palates.
articulation_point.wasath_lisan: The middle of the tongue rising to the roof of the mouth. (Touching for Jim; rising without touching for Shin and Ya).
articulation_point.hafah_lisan: The edge of the tongue (extending from the back to the tip of the edge) pressing against the inner wall of the upper molars on the left, right, or both.
articulation_point.adna_hafah_lisan: The tip of the tongue's edge (from the end of the Dhad makhraj to the tip of the tongue) touching the palate near the gums of the upper incisors.
articulation_point.tharaf_lisan: The tip of the tongue touching the palate near the gums of the upper incisors (slightly below the Lam makhraj).
articulation_point.tharaf_lisan_zhahr_adkhal: The tip of the tongue slightly entering the tip of the tongue's back (close to the Nun makhraj).
articulation_point.tharaf_lisan_ulya_tsanaya: The tip of the tongue touching the base of the upper incisors.
articulation_point.tharaf_lisan_tsanaya_sufla: The tip of the tongue positioned at the top of the lower incisors (not touching).
articulation_point.tharaf_lisan_athraf_tsanaya_ulya: The tip of the tongue touching the tip of the upper incisors.
articulation_point.bathn_syafah: The inner part of the lower lip touching the tip of the upper incisors.
articulation_point.syafatain: The two lips. (Rounding lips for Wawu; Closing lips for Ba; Closing lips with ghunnah for Mim).
articulation_point.khaisyum: The nasal cavity (base of the nose), from where the Ghunnah (nasal sound) possessed by letters Nun and Mim is emitted.

metadata.title: Interactive Tajweed Graph
metadata.description: Explore Makharijul Huruf and Sifatul Huruf through an interactive graph visualization. See how hijaiyyah letters connect to their articulation points and traits.

legend.title: Legend
legend.trait_lazimah_description: Lazimah Trait is a trait that is always present (permanent) in a letter.
legend.trait_aridhah_description: Aridhah Trait is a trait that is only present (conditional) in a letter under certain conditions.

quiz.select_mode_description: Choose the type of quiz you want to try
quiz.description_makhraj: Connect the letters to their correct articulation points
quiz.description_sifat: Connect the letters to their correct traits
quiz.instruction: Drag a line from a letter to the correct target, or tap two handles in a row on touch devices

welcome.title: Assalamualaikum!
welcome.description: Welcome to Tajweed Playground. May Allah ease your journey in learning Tajweed through this interactive visualization. Let's begin, Bismillah...

canvas.title: Interactive Area
canvas.description: This is the main area to explore the relationships between letters, Makhraj, and Sifat, complete with display settings and legends. Please click any letter, makhraj, or sifat shown on the screen.

controls.title: View Controls
controls.description: Use scroll or +/- buttons to zoom, drag to pan, the square icon to center the graph, and the lock icon to freeze the graph layout.

graph_filter.title: Settings Panel
graph_filter.description: Here you can adjust the graph display according to your needs. Please click to open the settings panel.

view_mode.title: View Mode
view_mode.description: Choose what to display: All, Makhraj only, Sifat only, or focus on a specific Letter. Please click 'Letter' to continue.

letter_selector.title: Hijaiyyah Selection
letter_selector.description: Masya Allah, there are 29 Hijaiyyah letters to explore. Select one letter to see its Makhraj and Sifat in detail.

layout_mode.title: Layout Mode
layout_mode.description: Choose between Radial layout (circular like the sun) or Hierarchy (tiered like a tree). Please try the Hierarchy mode.

hierarchy_direction.title: Hierarchy Direction
hierarchy_direction.description: Set the flow direction: Vertical (top to bottom) or Horizontal (left to right). Please select Horizontal.

edge_style.title: Edge Style
edge_style.description: Enable dynamic lines that follow node positions, or disable to select static line shapes. Please disable it to see line shape options.

edge_shape.title: Edge Shape
edge_shape.description: Choose the connecting line shape: Bezier (smooth curve), Straight, Step, or Smoothstep.

graph_legend.title: Color Legend
graph_legend.description: This panel explains the meaning of each node color. Please open it to continue.

legend_detail.title: Detail Info
legend_detail.description: This icon can be clicked to read more detailed explanations.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.description: Click the button to try some quiz examples.

locale_selector.title: Locale Selector
locale_selector.description: Select the language to use the app in the language of your choice. Currently available languages are Bahasa Indonesia and English.

theme_selector.title: Theme Selector
theme_selector.description: Select the theme to use the app in the theme of your choice. Available themes are light and dark.

waitlist_button.title: Waitlist
waitlist_button.description: Click this button to join the waitlist so we can notify you when the app is available, insyaa Allah.

end.title: We are done!
end.description: Thank you for following this guide. Please continue. Barakallahu fiikum
